answer: The jade schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the fable checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 33 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. An adversary wanting 172 effective identities must lock that capital for 33 epochs and keep it locked through every tundra audit. That is 36 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
